name: Occidental Petroleum
description: Occidental pumps oil, NGLs and natural gas in the US (Permian Basin and others), the Middle East and North Africa, and sells them at market prices; production averaged 1,434 Mboe/d in 2025. A smaller midstream and marketing segment gathers, processes and trades commodities and develops carbon-removal projects (the STRATOS direct air capture plant in Ector County, Texas, with BlackRock). Its chemicals business, OxyChem, was sold to Berkshire Hathaway for $9.7 billion cash on January 2, 2026 and is now reported as a discontinued operation, with proceeds earmarked for paying down debt.

employees.note: Headcount table total (6,793 US, 3,441 in the Middle East, 67 and 111 elsewhere per the table columns); excludes OxyChem employees, now a discontinued operation.

businessLines.name: Oil and gas
businessLines.how: Sells crude oil, NGLs and natural gas from the Permian and other US basins and from international fields (Oman and others) at market prices; some international volumes under production-sharing contracts.

businessLines.name: Midstream and marketing
businessLines.how: Buys, gathers, transports and processes oil and gas (marketing and pipelines margin) and runs low-carbon ventures (OLCV) such as STRATOS carbon removal, which so far is development spending rather than profit.

businessLines.name: OxyChem (discontinued, sold)
businessLines.how: Made and sold chemicals such as chlor-alkali and vinyls to industrial customers; sold to Berkshire Hathaway on 2026-01-02 for $9.7 billion cash (estimated $3.2 billion after-tax gain, subject to post-closing adjustments).

brands.name: OxyChem
brands.note: Sold to Berkshire Hathaway, closed 2026-01-02, $9.7 billion cash.

brands.name: STRATOS (direct air capture, joint venture with BlackRock)
brands.note: First large-scale DAC facility, Ector County, Texas.
